SOCIAL:
The bank endeavours to promote and
preserve gender and cultural diversi-
ty among our employee ranks through
transparent recruitment practices and
being a renown equal opportunity
employer.
We approach employee welfare by view-
ing each other as part of one big family
where each member’s welfare is our col-
lective responsibility. We invest in out-
of-office activities like sports and team
buildings in order not to lose focus of our
peoples individual needs and well being.
We have published and implemented
conclusive policies within our organiza-
tion that guide our engagement with spe-
cial needs categories such as People with
disabilities policy, HIV/Aids Policy towards
positive living etc.
We maintain constant Community dia-
logue and comply with industry code of
conduct and regulations.
SOCIO-ENVIRONMENTAL:
We facilitate our staff access to pro-
fessional advisors and counsellors on
matters relating to work, health, rela-
tionships and general social wellbeing.
Appropriate dressing and equipment
arrangements are in place for employees
whose work necessitates this, thus facili-
tating high staff productivity.
On climate change, we are cognizant of
our role in facilitating the decarburiza-
tion of the environment and enabling
renewable-energy scale up.
On environmental impact, we seek to es-
tablish partnerships with industry mem-
bers, government agencies, relevant en-
vironmental bodies, suppliers, customers
and the general public to promote and
achieve a high standard of environmen-
tal care.
On resource use, our bank’s environmen-
tal policy is to conduct business in a re-
sponsible manner through conservation,
optimal use of resources, energy saving
mechanisms and reduction of waste.
ENVIRONMENTAL:
On Waste Minimization, we’ve adopted a
3R Model of Reduce, Recycle and Re-use.
To translate to a low carbon economy we
help our customers mitigate their emis-
sions, save energy and reduce costs by
providing funding for energy efficiency
and renewable energy.
We maintain an open, honest and trans-
parent relationships with the regulators
and ensure compliance at all times.
Eco-system services and Bio-Diversity: The
bank has fully shifted to the use of green
gases on air conditioning equipment to
be in compliance with the Kyoto protocol
and the green environment envisaged in
the future.
We require our customers to provide
requisite approvals from authorities
tasked with environmental protection.
